edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the owner in approve.
msg.sender is used as the sender in transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender in transferFrom allowance check.
permit recovers and compares owner against supplied owner, not msg.sender, but msg.sender is the caller.
mint uses msg.sender in migrator comparison and event.
burn emits msg.sender in Burn event.
swap uses msg.sender in callback and Swap event.
dealSlippageWithIn is externally callable and can be called by msg.sender.
dealSlippageWithOut is externally callable and can be called by msg.sender.
skim is externally callable and lock-gated.
sync is externally callable and lock-gated.
createPair is externally callable to create pair.
permit requires deadline >= block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
_update reads block.timestamp to compute timeElapsed, making it timestamp dependent.
mint reads totalSupply for liquidity calculation.
burn reads totalSupply for pro-rata calculation.
burn reads token0 for balanceOf and transfer.
swap reads token0 for transfer and checks.
dealSlippageWithIn compares path token to token0.
dealSlippageWithOut compares path token to token0.
swap reads token1 for transfer and checks.
getTokenMarketPrice uses token1 indirectly via price inversion.
getAmountOutFinal uses token1 when token != token0.
getAmountInFinal uses token1 when token != token0.
dealSlippageWithIn uses token1 when path != token0.
dealSlippageWithOut uses token1 when path != token0.
mint uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
burn uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
swap uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
dealSlippageWithIn uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
dealSlippageWithOut uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
skim uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
sync uses lock modifier reading unlocked.
setFeeTo compares msg.sender with feeToSetter stored in factory.
createPair can be affected by migrator state through pair initialization path.
swap calls external SakeSwapCall callback before final reserve update, enabling reentrancy if lock is bypassed or integration is unsafe.
_update uses SafeMath.mul for encoded reserve products.
createPair calls initialize on the new pair.
_update contains unchecked timestamp and cumulative-price arithmetic.
_safeTransfer in burn performs low-level token transfer before state sync.
_safeTransfer in skim performs low-level token transfer.
amount0Out controls token0 output in swap.
amount1Out controls token1 output in swap.
to is the swap recipient and callback target.
data is forwarded to the swap callback.
path selects token direction for dealSlippageWithIn.
amountIn is exact input for dealSlippageWithIn.
